records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Glad to hear the first week has gone smoothly — and yes, let's do that walkthrough.

On your open ticket about adding people one by one: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, so you shouldn't have to grind through your list. Tariq is still following up with the details there.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk you through getting your team's projects and tasks set up and answer anything else while we're on.

Best,
Nadia
